zoe_cs: Heads-up: CargoVertex (contact: ops@cargovertex) asked to onboard a custom manifest summarizer + redactor. Requirements: Private in-customer VPC, HSM for key ops, strict PII masking (mask, not remove), and low-latency lookups p95 <= 300ms. They want an eval plan + notes on how this affects renewal if they need reserved capacity. Who can pick this up?
harry_se: I'll take SE. Quick facts needed: model framework/size, expected QPS, and whether they will allow telemetry (hashed) for quality monitoring.
zoe_cs: Ops replied: PyTorch 2.0, ~5.5B, realtime single-row queries, QPS ~15 steady. Telemetry OK if hashed and only kept under NDA. They request no persistent token logs and ephemeral KV cache.
leah_safety: Safety check: define PII fields (names, phone, shipment_id, customs_id). We'll need adversarial redaction probes and an extraction accuracy run. Also confirm region-specific rules for EU customs refs.
sam_pm: Product note: ephemeral KV only; we'll need infra sign-off for Dedicated/vpc sizing to meet 300ms p95. That is likely to drive a Dedicated suggestion which ties into renewal/commercial. Tagging @mina_sales.
infra_bot: infra-bot created ticket CS-9444 "cargovertex manifest redaction onboarding" https://redwood.atlassian.io/browse/CS-9444 :white_check_mark:
harry_se: Ops asks: please send ~400 representative rows + schema. Plan to run perf with int8 quant and `--ephemeral-kv` off then on to compare tails. Example run:
```
./perf_test --model cv_artifact.pt --data cv_samples.jsonl --qps 15 --concurrency 4 --quantize int8 --ephemeral-kv --out cv_perf.json
```
ETA 48-72h after samples.
leah_safety: Eval deliverables: redaction FNR/FPR, high-severity misses, extraction precision/recall, p95/p99 latency at 10/15/25 QPS. Need samples by Fri to keep timelines.
zoe_cs: I'll request data and NDA addendum from ops now, schedule technical sync for Tue 2pm PT. Mina, can you start a draft pricing note for Dedicated+HSM?
mina_sales: Will do. I'll prepare a preliminary term sketch and join the sync.
zoe_cs: Thanks all — I'll update CS-9444 when data lands. :thumbsup:
